Technical SEO.title: Google November 2026 Core Update Ranking Flux - What We're Seeing
Technical SEO.summary: The Google November 2026 Core Update began rolling out on November 10th, and chatter has been more muted than usual, with third-party tracking tools reportedly struggling to monitor the ranking changes accurately.

Technical SEO.title: Google Search Analytics API Adds Branded Queries, Multimodal & Country/Devices Filters
Technical SEO.summary: Google has expanded the Search Analytics API to support filtering by branded queries, multimodal web data, and multi-country and multi-device combinations — features previously available only in the Search Console UI.

Technical SEO.title: Google Adds Branded & Multimodal Data To Search Console API
Technical SEO.summary: The Search Analytics API now supports branded query classification, multimodal search data, and the ability to filter by multiple countries or devices in a single API request.

Technical SEO.title: When The WordPress Plugin Update Is The Security Risk: Why SEOs Should Pay Attention
Technical SEO.summary: Compromised WordPress plugins can introduce both security vulnerabilities and SEO problems, with recent supply-chain attacks highlighting why plugin updates and vendor trust require closer scrutiny from SEO teams.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google's Ask Maps Starts Finding Appointments & Calling Businesses
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google's Ask Maps feature is now finding appointments online and placing automated calls to local businesses on behalf of users, with implications for how Business Profiles handle AI-driven customer interactions.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: CMS Market Share Trends: Top Content Management Systems (Nov 2026)
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The CMS market is fragmenting, and platform choice now carries direct implications for scalability, SEO performance, and revenue growth at the enterprise level.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Bloomreach goes back to its roots with AthenaHQ acquisition
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Bloomreach acquired AthenaHQ with the goal of connecting conversational discovery directly to customer revenue, aiming to prove ROI in AI search for commerce brands.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Mode Drops Gemini Label & Rolls Out Gemini 4 Carbon To Pro Subs
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has removed the Gemini model label from the AI Mode interface header and expanded access to Gemini 4 Carbon for Pro subscribers, a model previously limited to Ultra subscribers, as confirmed by a Google engineer.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT citation drops look like unannounced Google core updates
AI Search / GEO.summary: Drops in ChatGPT citation patterns are being compared to unannounced Google core updates, suggesting that AI citation volatility may require the same monitoring discipline as traditional algorithm tracking.

AI Search / GEO.title: Cendyn Report Links Generative Engine Optimization to Direct Organic Search Gains
AI Search / GEO.summary: A Cendyn report connects GEO strategies to measurable organic search gains, making it directly relevant to hospitality and travel brands managing enterprise SEO alongside AI-answer surface visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT Tests Web Results, See More & Other Search Results Formats
AI Search / GEO.summary: OpenAI is testing web-only search result variations in ChatGPT, including a see-more button for AI answers and other interface formats, signaling continued evolution of how ChatGPT surfaces and attributes web content.

AI Search / GEO.title: 40-domain study: 80% of Shopify stores expose /API/ucp/MCP, 0% /agents.md
AI Search / GEO.summary: A 40-domain study found that 80% of Shopify stores expose a specific API endpoint used by AI agents, while none have implemented an agents.md file, indicating a significant gap in deliberate AI-agent readiness across e-commerce sites.

AI Search / GEO.title: How to protect brand reputation in the AI era
AI Search / GEO.summary: As brand narratives are increasingly shaped by AI and third-party sources rather than owned channels, the piece outlines strategies for managing reputation across search, AI answer surfaces, and external references.
